AI-Based Animal Detection and Instant Alert System

## 1\. Description

AGRI GUARD 360 is an AI-based crop protection system designed to detect animals entering agricultural areas. A laptop camera captures the surroundings, and a Teachable Machine AI model classifies the detected object as Animal or Human. When an animal is detected with sufficient confidence, the system activates an LED and buzzer, displays the alert on the LCD, and sends an instant notification to the farmer's mobile phone through Telegram.

## 2\. Materials Required

1.Hardware  
2.Arduino UNO  
3.HC-05 Bluetooth Module  
4.CP210x USB-to-TTL Converter  
5.Laptop with webcam  
6.16×2 I2C LCD Display  
7.LED  
8.220Ω Resistor  
9.Buzzer  
10.Breadboard  
11.Jumper Wires  
12.USB Cable  
13.1kΩ Resistors for HC-05 RX voltage divider  
14.Software  
15.Arduino IDE  
16.Python  
17.Flask  
18.HTML / JavaScript  
19.TensorFlow.js  
20.Google Teachable Machine  
21.Telegram Bot  
22.Web Browser

## 3\. Working

The system works in the following sequence:  
Camera → AI Model → Flask → HC-05 → Arduino → Alert \+ Telegram  
The laptop webcam continuously captures the surrounding scene.The Teachable Machine model analyzes the camera image.The AI classifies the detected object as Animal or Human.A detection is accepted only when the confidence is sufficiently high and the result remains stable for multiple frames.If an animal is detected:  
Arduino receives the a command.LED turns ON.Buzzer turns ON.  
LCD displays ANIMAL DETECTED / ALERT\!Flask sends a notification through the Telegram Bot.If a human is detected:Arduino receives the H command.LED and buzzer remain OFF.  
LCD displays HUMAN DETECTED / SAFE.If the AI cannot clearly identify the object, it displays NO CLEAR DETECTION and does not trigger the animal alert.

## 4\. Notes

1.The AI model is trained using two classes: Animals and Human.  
2.The system uses a confidence threshold to reduce false detections.  
3.Multiple consecutive predictions are required before sending an alert.  
4.Telegram provides a real-time mobile notification without requiring an additional GSM module.  
5.The Telegram Bot Token must be kept private and should never be shared publicly.  
6.The HC-05 communicates with the Arduino through serial communication.  
7.The CP210x converter provides the USB-to-serial connection between the laptop and HC-05.  
8.For better accuracy, the AI model should be trained with more real-world images of local animals and different lighting conditions.  
9.The current prototype uses a laptop webcam and is suitable for demonstration/prototyping.
